mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin (name, description, tags, enabled, current_revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{enabled}, #{currentRevision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tags}, enabled = #{enabled}, current_revision = #{currentRevision}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_version (plugin_id, revision, filename, content, content_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{pluginId}, #{revision}, #{filename}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS plugin_id, p.name AS plugin_name, tp.revision, pv.filename, pv.content_hash, pv.content, p.enabled, tp.bound_at FROM task_plugin tp JOIN plugin p ON p.id = tp.plugin_id JOIN plugin_version pv ON pv.plugin_id = tp.plugin_id AND pv.revision = tp.revision WHERE tp.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY p.name, p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_plugin (task_id, plugin_id, revision, bound_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{pluginId}, #{revision}, #{boundAt})
